subject: Establishing standby roster and surge coverage for May hiring sprint
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: May hiring sprint — interviewer coverage needed

Vanessa / Lauren —

We just had a slate bump: Greenhouse shows ~28 new onsite/timezone-confirmed interviews for next two weeks across Infra/Product. TalentWorks is sending three more high-priority candidates and scheduling is already tight. Can we stand up a small standby roster (2–3 people/day) to absorb late swaps and no-shows?

Immediate asks:
- Confirm who can be on standby from May 3–14 (US PST/MST/EST windows).
- Agree on shadow vs live rules for junior interviewers (we prefer shadow-first on hard-skill loops).
- Share calendar blocks so TalentWorks can book flex slots.

I've attached the hiring blocks (.ics) and started a roster CSV with proposed coverage.

Attachment: may-hiring-blocks.ics (calendar blocks)
Attachment: standby-roster-v1.csv

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: May hiring sprint — interviewer coverage needed

Thanks Naomi — good catch. Quick proposal:

Plan (high level)
- Build 3-tier standby roster: Primary (covers full live loops), Secondary (shadow and step-in), Reserve (on-call for no-shows).
- Each day: 2 primary (product/infra split), 2 secondary, 1 reserve.
- Shift windows: 8–11am PST, 11am–2pm PST, 2–5pm PST to map to EST/MST overlap.

Rules:
- Secondary should shadow the first 15 minutes of live loops, then explicitly step in only if candidate consents.
- Reserve gets paid on-call stipend per shift (recruiting approves).
- No interviewer should exceed 4 live loops/day unless they opt-in.

Next steps for today:
- Karthik, can you share which engineers are travel-blocked or out during May 3–14?
- Marcus/Marissa, please volunteer preferred standby days; I'll slot you and ping managers for approvals.
- Naomi, please send TalentWorks the 3 slot windows and ask them to use the attached .ics blocks.

I'll draft a short runbook and update the roster CSV with confirmed volunteers.

— Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

Team —

Thanks for the quick responses. Finalized items below (I updated the Google sheet and attached the roster CSV):

1) Confirmed standby coverage (May 3–14)
- Primaries: Marcus Lin (mornings), Karthik Iyer (May 6 & 11 mid-day), Marissa Cole (May 9 & 13 afternoons)
- Secondaries: Lauren Bishop (shadow all days), Vanessa Ortiz (reserve on-call May 4–8)
- Reserve stipend approved by Recruiting (Naomi) — details in HR portal

2) Runbook highlights (short)
- Shadow etiquette: secondary should mute/make notes for first 15 mins. Candidate consent checkbox required in invite.
- Step-in flow: PM/Recruiter confirms candidate consent, calendar owner forwards control to the step-in interviewer.
- No more than 4 live loops/day per engineer unless opt-in.

3) Ops for TalentWorks / Greenhouse
- Naomi: please instruct TalentWorks to use the three ICS blocks attached and copy greenhouse@jobs.io on bookings so our scheduler can auto-assign.
- Attached roster CSV has a "confirm_by" column; please update within 24 hours of receiving a booking.

Attachments: standby-roster-v1.csv, may-hiring-blocks.ics

I'll run a 15-min sync tomorrow at 10am PST to walk through the runbook and answer questions. If anyone has a manager pushback, loop me in and I'll handle approvals.

— Vanessa
Director, Talent Operations
Redwood Inference
